bulkBand: Older invoices are moving to the current settings · {{done}} of {{total}}

errors.warnEdgeRange: Enter a whole number between 10 and 400.
errors.warnWeightRange: Enter a whole number between 1 and 999.

company.title: Company
company.desc: The company name shown on invoices and reports.

tolerances.title: Comparison tolerances
tolerances.desc: Deviations within these limits are not counted as differences. A measurement deviation that does not change the billed weight is never counted as a difference.
tolerances.edgeHelp: This margin is added to every edge of your measurement. If the carrier's weight falls within it, the line counts as compliant. Enter 0 to apply no margin.
tolerances.amountHelp: Anything above the expected amount by this much counts as a price difference. Entered in your company's currency; converted at the exchange rate on foreign-currency invoices.
tolerances.unknownSurcharges: Count surcharges not in the tariff as differences
tolerances.unknownSurchargesHelp: When off (recommended), surcharges your tariff does not define are added to Expected at the invoiced amount. When on, they count entirely as differences. Existing invoices keep the old setting; after saving you are asked whether to move them.
tolerances.recompare: Move old invoices to the new settings

fx.title: Exchange rate
fx.desc: If the tariff is in a different currency than the invoice (e.g. USD tariff, EUR invoice), the expected amount is converted at the shipment-day rate.
fx.sourceHelp: On weekends and holidays, the previous business day's rate is used

mobile.title: Mobile measurement
mobile.desc: Dimensional weight, mandatory photo and measurement warning rules shown on the employee's phone.
mobile.divisorHelp: Shown to the employee. A 40×30×25 box = {{desi}} dimensional weight
mobile.photosHelp: A measurement cannot be saved without this many box photos (0–10)
mobile.warnEdgeHelp: A longer side makes the phone ask “Please check”; saving is not blocked (10–400)
mobile.warnWeightHelp: A heavier box shows the same warning (1–999)
mobile.scaleAiReadHelp: When on, each reading uses your AI allowance. When off, the photo is kept as evidence and the weight is entered manually.

refCard.title: Reference card
refCard.desc: Print the card and place it next to the box; the box is measured from a single photo with the card in it.
refCard.step1: Print the PDF on A4 paper; the printer scale must be 100% ("Fit to page" off).
refCard.step2: Measure the line on the card with a ruler: it must be exactly 100 mm.
refCard.step3: Cut out the card, lay it flat on the table right next to the box (not on top) and select the "Reference card" method on mobile.
refCard.downloadFailed: Could not download the reference card

demo.title: Data management
demo.desc: Reset the system to empty, or load sample data. Accounts, company name, settings and box presets are kept either way.

reset.title: Reset system
reset.desc: All carriers, tariffs, measurements (with their photos) and invoices are deleted.

samples.title: Load sample data
samples.desc: Existing data is deleted; sample carriers (FedEx, Aras…), tariffs and measurements are loaded.

modal.label: Data
modal.bodyReset: All carriers, tariffs, measurements and invoices will be permanently deleted; this cannot be undone. Accounts and settings are kept.
modal.bodySamples: All carriers, tariffs, measurements and invoices will be permanently deleted; this cannot be undone. Sample data is then loaded. Accounts and settings are kept.

toast.resetBody: No carriers, tariffs, measurements or invoices remain. Accounts and settings were kept. The setup wizard starts over.

presets.title: Box presets
presets.desc: Selected with one tap on mobile, and the dimensions fill in automatically (K1, K2, K3...). Change the order with the arrows.

modal.label: Box preset
modal.deleteBody: Past measurements are not affected. To only deactivate it, clear the "Active" checkbox.

reminders.title: Dispute deadline reminder
reminders.help: For invoices with discrepancies and no dispute sent, people with the Admin or Accounting role get an email 3 days and 1 day before the last day.
